scope_map.approval_scope: scope framework only; it does not accept sources, topics, or country completion

policy: Coverage is issue-led and separate from source acceptance. A topic remains incomplete until its required legal, implementing, procedure/practice and remedy layers have current, route-specific evidence. Each evidence record identifies real files under local_artifact_paths and labels whether it is statutory text, an official procedure artifact, or a project-authored summary. Source IDs are metadata keys; a URL or locator is not a source document. Files proposed in PR #168 remain proposal-only until merged.
